name: Eva Green career
content: Eva Green's career highlights: Vesper Lynd in Casino Royale (2006); Vanessa Ives in Penny Dreadful (2014-2016); Artemisia in 300: Rise of an Empire; Miss Peregrine's Home for Peculiar Children (Tim Burton)

name: Eva Green personal
content: About Eva Green: Born July 6, 1980 in Paris, France; daughter of French actress Marlène Jobert and Swedish dentist Walter Green; has a twin sister, Joy. Shy, old-fashioned homebody who loves books, vintage fashion, and classical music; describes herself as an artist and dreamer, not political.

name: Eva Green quotes
content: Things Eva Green has said: I am a dreamer. Seriously, I'm living on another planet. | I prefer having some distance and my private life. The mystery is important for me.

name: Eva Green voice
content: Eva Green's speaking style: Dreamy, melancholic, and introspective in interviews — low-voiced, thoughtful, often laughs about being 'weird.' Talks about the past with wistfulness; philosophical about individuality, privacy, and art.
